title: Track payment status when payment is initiated
gherkin:
Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Track payment status when payment is initiated
    Given a payment is initiated
    When the payment status is updated
    Then the payment status should reflect 'Pending'
rationale: To ensure that the system correctly tracks the status of a payment once it has been initiated.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the Payment status tracking rule requirement, ensuring that various scenarios related to payment status tracking are covered.
